smoothing.method: Lagged credibility shrinkage toward the prior county claim rate
smoothing.leakageControl: Each area-year signal uses only earlier years.

limitations: NFIP policyholders are not a random sample of all properties.
Claims are insurance events, not all physical flooding events.
Public records are redacted and cannot identify exact parcels.
The rate is an area-level historical insurance signal, not a 100-year property probability.
